text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Note: This video will self-destruct in 
30 seconds.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, well? Who would have thought this 
movie was a spy thriller?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought I had conquered most of the 
works. Silly Chan, so careless.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~, being a spy really does seem fun. I 
would love to press a single button and 
launch a car seat flying whoosh into the 
air too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"How many more are there in this series? I 
need to watch them all before the new 
movie comes out—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan ended up staying up 
late, completely captivated by the spy 
movie.
